006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupMultiline;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
010import dev.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint.impl.DefaultLet;
012import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
013import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
016
017/**
018 * Represents a variable assignment for use in Metaschema module constraints.
019 */
020public interface ILet {
021  /**
022   * Create a new Let expression by compiling the provided Metapath expression
023   * string.
024   * <p>
025   * This method is deprecated. Callers should use
026   * {@link #of(IEnhancedQName, IMetapathExpression, ISource, MarkupMultiline)}
027   * instead.
028   *
029   * @param name
030   *          the let expression variable name
031   * @param valueExpression
032   *          a Metapath expression string representing the variable value
033   * @param source
034   *          the source descriptor for the resource containing the constraint
035   * @param remarks
036   *          remarks about the let statement
037   * @return the original let statement with the same name or {@code null}
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  @Deprecated(since = "2.2.0", forRemoval = true)
041  static ILet of(
042      @NonNull IEnhancedQName name,
043      @NonNull String valueExpression,
044      @NonNull ISource source,
045      @Nullable MarkupMultiline remarks) {
046    return of(
047        name,
048        IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(valueExpression, source.getStaticContext()),
049        source,
050        remarks);
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Create a new Let expression.
055   *
056   * @param name
057   *          the let expression variable name
058   * @param valueExpression
059   *          a Metapath expression representing the variable value
060   * @param source
061   *          the source descriptor for the resource containing the constraint
062   * @param remarks
063   *          remarks about the let statement
064   * @return the original let statement with the same name or {@code null}
065   */
066  @NonNull
067  static ILet of(
068      @NonNull IEnhancedQName name,
069      @NonNull IMetapathExpression valueExpression,
070      @NonNull ISource source,
071      @Nullable MarkupMultiline remarks) {
072    return new DefaultLet(name, valueExpression, source, remarks);
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get a stable identifier for this let statement, suitable for use in SARIF
077   * output and timing correlation.
078   * <p>
079   * Generates a deterministic identifier based on the variable name, source
080   * location, and value expression.
081   *
082   * @return a non-null identifier string
083   */
084  @NonNull
085  default String getInternalIdentifier() {
086    String localName = getName().getLocalName();
087    String source = getSource().getLocationHint();
088    String expression = getValueExpression().getPath();
089    int hash = (source + "|" + expression).hashCode();
090    return ObjectUtils.notNull("let-" + localName + "-" + String.format("%08x", hash));
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Get the name of the let variable.
095   *
096   * @return the name
097   */
098  @NonNull
099  IEnhancedQName getName();
100
101  /**
102   * Get the Metapath expression to use to query the value.
103   *
104   * @return the Metapath expression to use to query the value
105   */
106  @NonNull
107  IMetapathExpression getValueExpression();
108
109  /**
110   * Information about the source resource containing the let statement.
111   *
112   * @return the source information
113   */
114  @NonNull
115  ISource getSource();
116
117  /**
118   * Get the remarks associated with the let statement.
119   *
120   * @return the remark or {@code null} if no remarks are defined
121   */
122  @Nullable
123  MarkupMultiline getRemarks();
124}
